artist.name: Diggy Dang
artist.bio: Diggy Dang is a founding member of Reggae Rajahs, the New Delhi crew described as India's first reggae sound system, and co-founder of the ska jazz band The Ska Vengers. He works as a singer, guitarist, DJ and label manager, and has spent more than 15 years promoting reggae.

press.title: Reggae is taking root in the streets of New Delhi
